index_metadata.generator: inline-python archaeology (no repo helper scripts written)
index_metadata.worktree_registry_note: .slim/worktrees.json lists 12 older lanes; physical worktrees present are golden-io-v2, golden-sep14-repro, odirect-shadow-sep14, golden-p4-8-durability, rx3 (unregistered/excluded).

c0_fd_ready.runs_correction_note: Corrected 0 -> 15 per additional15_index.json (15 receipt-bound C0-FD-ready confirmations, all request_ids present as c0_fd_ready_cohort rows).

coverage.field_note: run_fingerprint from v2ctl invocation manifests; profile_config_fingerprint from per-run summary/attempt; deployment_fingerprint from attempt identity or named-cohort index.
coverage.new_column_notes: worktree/branch/commit/workspace/GPU/deployment_id-receipt populated from matching .v2ctl deploy manifests (exact deploy_fingerprint, else unambiguous 8-hex prefix, else unambiguous app-level). SEP14 V1/V2 15x15 RAW_INDEX.json and additional15_index.json supply container_id, queue_depth, read_chunk_bytes, fd_strategy, thread_process_topology, reader_process_count, pinned_arena_details, clip/unet_load_ms, total_source_read_wall_ms, source_read_count, median/maximum_read_ms and reads_ge_* for their 30 and 15 request_ids respectively. storage_path is V1/V2 from the sep14 profile/volume flags. buffered_or_direct and read_primitive remain unknown where no explicit primitive/backing field exists; no value was inferred. Rows without per-read telemetry keep read metrics blank.

parsing_method.representation: one row per unique request_id across all discovered attempt artifacts; duplicate copies (worktree duplicates, v2ctl evidence bundle copies) are collapsed into the row and recorded in all_raw_paths and RAW_EVIDENCE_INDEX.csv.
parsing_method.large_files: chunked regex first-match scan (8MB blocks, 4KB overlap) of a curated field set; only fields present early/anywhere are captured, others remain unknown (never fabricated).
parsing_method.v2ctl_runs: json.load of invocation manifests; merged into the run row by request_id when an attempt exists, otherwise emitted as manifest-only rows.
parsing_method.named_cohorts: field-complete rows from the cohort_table.json (27-run) and additional15_index.json (15-run) derived indices that were built from the raw attempts; raw attempt paths retained.

raw_vs_derived.raw: attempt_0.json / attempt.json / attempt_0_events.json, .v2ctl runs/deployments/gates/confirmations/source-probes/evidence JSON, per-read event table source bytes.
raw_vs_derived.derived: cohort_table.json, run_index.json, series_stats.json, additional15_index.json, evidence_index.json, EXPERIMENT_EVIDENCE_*.md, the odirect per-read event table (derived from raw child read events).

limitations: Total discovered attempt-artifact bytes ~47.6 GB across 6,172 files, dominated by duplicated deep-trace copies; large files were scanned with first-match regex rather than fully parsed, so nested stage-level fields (clip/unet/vae stage walls, FRR) are often unknown for them.

Per-read telemetry exists only as a derived event table for the odirect-shadow experiment (18 rows); no raw per-read event JSON/JSONL was located elsewhere, so GOLDEN_HISTORICAL_READS_MASTER.csv contains only those rows (nothing fabricated).
request_id was read from the first 16KB of each attempt file; files with the field later are keyed by path instead.
Some deep-trace attempt files are >30MB and may be truncated reads on mounted storage; parse errors are recorded per-row where they occurred.
The .v2ctl/worktrees registry is stale relative to physical worktrees; physical directories were enumerated directly.
Reports/summary-only rows are included and flagged when no raw attempt artifact exists; they are not treated as raw.
index_metadata.applicable_policy: No existing repository file was modified; only the four requested deliverables were written at the repository root. No benchmark/deploy/checkout/cleanup was run.
index_metadata.update_scope: Added requested explicit columns to the four root deliverables only; existing rows/paths preserved; named_cohorts.c0_fd_ready.runs corrected to 15.
